<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/workspace.ts -->
<!--
  Work items in lanes. Each lane has a title, a count and its cards; a card has a title, an optional tag and the
  person it belongs to. Axes: card (simple, detail: tag and person), cols (2, 3), tone, density. Moving a card
  between lanes is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Lane, BoardCard } from "./kanban-board.types";

  export type KanbanBoardProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lanes: Lane[];
    cards: BoardCard[];
    countLabel: string;
    card?: "simple" | "detail";
    cols?: "2" | "3";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import Pill from "../components/pill.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lanes,
    cards,
    countLabel,
    card = "detail",
    cols = "3",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: KanbanBoardProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "2") ? "1-2" : "1-3")} class="items-start gap-4" data-testid="lanes">
    {#each lanes as lane (lane.id)}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-muted p-4" data-testid="lane">
        <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
          <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
            {lane.title}
          </Title>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {tpl(countLabel, (cards.filter((i) => !lane.key || i["lane"] === lane.key)?.length ?? 0))}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          {#each cards.filter((i) => !lane.key || i["lane"] === lane.key) as c (c.id)}
            <ListItem
              class={cn(
                "flex flex-col rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border",
                (((density as string) === "compact") ? "gap-2 p-2" : "gap-2 p-4")
              )}
              data-testid="item"
            >
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {c.title}
              </Text>
              {#if ((card as string) === "detail")}
                <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
                  <Pill tone="blue" icon="tag">
                    {c.tag}
                  </Pill>
                  <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                    {c.who}
                  </Text>
                </Group>
              {/if}
            </ListItem>
          {/each}
        </List>
      </Stack>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
